jobs_results.title: Project Manager IT in Las Palmas
jobs_results.description:
The ocean plays a significant role in addressing the major challenges we face today, such as offshore wind energy, deep-sea mining, maritime safety, and carbon footprint reduction. The maritime sector is actively working on solutions to tackle these challenges. Affordable and efficient cross-supply chain collaboration to ensure timely delivery is a challenge that requires attention. Companies are already stepping up to drive these efforts. Floorganise is actively engaged in shaping this future. Join us on this journey, utilizing your programming skills in either Zwolle (Netherlands) or our new office in Las Palmas de Gran Canaria (Spain).

Floorganise. Triggering smart Shipbuilding

As a project manager, you proactively engage in the internal improvement processes of our shipbuilding clients. Whether it involves shortening lead times, reducing risks, working hours, or enhancing the predictability of production standards. Your technical background (in business administration and IT... enables you to swiftly grasp shipbuilding and the challenges faced by our clients. You promptly identify potential improvement measures, partly due to the insights our MES application provides.

Your familiarity with Lean practices, along with your natural curiosity for finding ways to make things better, enables you to effectively lead projects and initiatives focused on improvement. Collaborating with your colleagues (the software development team) in Zwolle, you establish and oversee (sub) projects through to completion. For you, a commitment is steadfast, the customer comes first, your approach is organized, you foster a cooperative spirit, and occasional international travel (about 2 times a year for a week) posesnoissue.

PS: Did you know that the average age at Floorganise is 33yearsold?

We are a young company with big ambitions. There are more and more shipyards worldwide that are looking for a solution to bridge the distance between the office and the shop floor. Our Floor2Plan application supports them in a series of steps that occur in the primary process of shipbuilding. In addition to carrying out projects, we are very busy with R&D. The project manager also plays an important role in this.Namely, identifying improvement measures (based on the knowledge developed by our customers and their more generic issues), elaborating into improvement proposals and ensuring their implementation (testing what our developers engineer for this purpose). At Floorganise you have an excellent opportunity to develop and grow. You will also receive support from us in the form of training,courses,etc.
• You are ambitious and want to develop yourself
• You are customer oriented
• Willing to travel internationally occasionally
• You have knowledge and or further interest in LEAN
• You like to work independently, but in a good team
• Bachelor degree work level, towards mechanical engineering, IT shipbuilding, industrial engineering or similar
• Experience in managing(improvement)projects
• Beautiful challenging assignments, interesting and large clients
• Experienced and expert colleagues in a trusted permanent team
• A pleasant workplace, working with the latest tools
• You can work part-time with us and you will receive a competitve salary and benefits
• You get all the space for your personal development. You can see this very broadly in termsofeducation.

Major global players with tens of thousands of employees, such as Boskalis and IHC Merwede, have been working every day with our tools and ideas every day for many years. More than 300 dredgers, trailing suction hopper dredgers, luxury mega yachts and other large-scale shipbuilding projects have already been realized with Floorganise. We keep satisfied customers and we get new customers because our developers are constantly working on improving and expanding. Our customers realize significant savings in time and money through Floorganise.Damen, Boskalis, Van Oord, Zwijnenburg, Feadship, IHC Merwede, Nichols Brothers Boat Builders, Niestern Sander, Van Lent, Philly Shipyard, Oceanco, Van der Loo, Detyens, Mercury andIconYachts.

Want to know more?

Give us a call directly or send us a mail with your resume. We are looking forward toyourresponse!

Give Ronald a call at Ver el número de teléfono en click.appcast.io or mail to ronald(at) floorganise.com . You can reach him during and afterofficehours.

#J-18808-Ljbffr

jobs_results.title: Testing Project Manager (LQA)
jobs_results.description:
We are currently hiring an experienced and dynamic Testing Project Manager (LQA) for our Localization Testing Department.

To be successful in this role, you should a minimum of 3 years of experience working as a Testing Project Manager (LQA), preferably having worked at some point for a testing service provider. As a Testing Project Manager (LQA), you will manage testing projects from RFQ to the final delivery. You will be in direct contact with clients and have full ownership of project execution.

You will deliver respecting the agreed timelines and budgets, providing high quality standards at all times.
RESPONSIBILITIES

Take full ownership of each phase in the project life cycle

Point of contact for clients

Preparation of proposals for RFQ’s

Creation of test plans and strategies

Testing media and hardware preparation

Manage internal and client databases

Successfully prepare and execute multilingual projects within agreed timelines and budgets

Coordinate and manage multiple... testing teams

Evaluate and select testers
REQUIREMENTS

Advanced Project Management skills including strong communication, planning, organizational and reporting skills

Ability to follow instructions

Follow Company policy and values

Follow established processes and create new ones

Experienced in project planning, budgeting, risk analysis, mitigation, resource planning and organization

Execution and management of multiple teams

Capacity to take ownership of the project and successfully solve unexpected issues

Proactive and positive “can do” attitude

Capacity to work as a team member as well as independently

Capacity to manage multilingual projects in a dynamic and fast-paced work environment where schedule changes are part of planning

Hardware knowledge including updating firmware, transferring and launching digital media, debug and PC tools

Experience with online and mobile testing

Understanding the importance of quality, customer service, confidentiality and security

Able to negotiate effectively without compromising relationships on either side of the chain

Willingness to improve and learn, support other team members and go the extra mile

Tools: Jira, Mantis, Test Track Pro, DevTrack

IT literacy: especially Microsoft Office suite, Visio

Languages: English at a native or near native level. Other languages are a plus
WHAT WE OFFER

Relocation pack

2 months summer timetable

Free yearly medical check

Cafeteria with arcade and console games
#J-18808-Ljbffr

jobs_results.title: International Project Manager TIC Industry (f/m/d)
jobs_results.description:
International Project Manager TIC Industry (f/m/d)

The profession is offered at several locations offered:Köln,Nürnberg,El Prat de Llobregat,Courbevoie,Madrid
Job Description
• As International Project Manager TIC Industry (f/m/d), you will work in the field of auditing and certification for international key accounts to be the main contact person, problem solver and care taker to our customers, mainly from the automotive industry.
• As the main contact person you build, maintain and intensify relationships with existing key account customers, encompassing customer support and coordination of the entire audit and certification process from order creation to invoicing.
• You are responsible for planning, contract implementation, monitoring and controlling of the global audit programs of our key accounts, in close collaboration with the customers, key account managers, our affiliate offices and technical competence centers around the world.
• You control the process with regard to... deadlines, customer expectations and budget as well as provide clear guidance to all stakeholders and coordinate at the internal interfaces to sales, certification, foreign subsidiaries and commercial department.
• The Project Manager leads or coordinates the audit planning, resourcing, staffing, subcontract management, progress reporting, troubleshooting and establishes a communication concept to ensure information flow between all project participants and an effective stakeholder management.
Experience & Further Qualifications
• Join our team, if you enjoy working in an international environment, got project management experience, are a strong communicator and find joy in managing customer relationships and providing excellent customer service (3+ years of professional working experience in testing, inspection and certification (TIC Industry))
• Bachelor‘s Degree or equivalent combination of education and or experience
• Experience in ISO/IEC and IATF certification business and planning of large audit programs for complex customers
• Excellent verbal and written languages skills in English and Spanish (German is beneficial but not required)
• Team player with strong communication as well as interpersonal skills and a strong customer orientation
• Proficient computer and software skills (especially MS Office, SAP helpful) are needed
#J-18808-Ljbffr

jobs_results.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
At SD Worx Spain, we are focused on building capability and flexibility to meet the growth of the business whilst increasing the profitability across the organisation. We support SD Worx on most of the business areas such as HR, Finance, Marketing, Software Development, Testing, Implementation and Service Delivery. There are numerous opportunities at SD Worx Spain for people with the right blend of skills, experience and character! Are you ready to join us?

Scope Management

-Assuring SoW is covered

-Identify and agree the clear boundaries of the project,

-Identify and agree deliverables including the approval / sign-off process.

-Direct tasks and work packages internally

-Escalation point for clients and internal teams

-Identify out of scope tasks and move them into the CR process

-CR and Opportunity Management

-Ensure go-live readiness

-Assure hyper care and hand-over to maintenance

Resource Management

-Address any staffing requirement to staffing management

-Identify... skills and expertise needs

Schedule Management

-Schedule all project activities and align with customer

-Implement or choose project life-cycle method

-Monitor progress, and adapt schedule where and if required

-Prioritizing work and maintaining the backlog

-Leading any client related task and action

Customer Relationship Management (CRM)

-Monitor, manage and foster strong customer relationship

-Ensure client satisfaction

-Identify upselling and cross selling opportunities

-Proactively communicate with customers on progress / challenges

Stakeholder & Communication Management

-Interface with all internal and external SD Worx Partners (MPS, IMP, Staffing, global AMO, Sales, AMS internally, suppliers)

-Manage transition from project to run

-Manage client and top-management reporting (functional and financials in sdworx internal dashboards)

-Drive process improvement within the Global PMO

Risk & Opportunity Management

-Manage issues and risks

-Manage escalations

-Identify opportunities and align with internal sdworx stakeholders

Financial Management / Procurement Management

-Responsible for client financial management as contracted and additional services:

-Budget (contracted revenue)

-Actuals (invoicing, accruals)

-Costs (planned costs)

-Forecast (rolling forecast)

-Invoicing (initiate and assure timely invoicing)

-Manages 3rd party invoices and approves them

Quality management

-Determine and implement project quality control processes

-Determine test-strategy and test-plan

-Execute quality assurance and control

-Assure project is executed to industry standard(s)

What do we have to offer?
• An attractive salary based on your experience and achievement. And the freedom to compose your personal benefit package.
• A dynamic environment: flexible working hours and working from home
• Learning opportunities: through an individual development plan and professional training
• Career growth: whether you want to become more of an expert in your field our you want to expand your knowledge more horizontally, there is always room to grow within SD Worx

jobs_results.title: Senior Technical Project Manager - 4699
jobs_results.description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Technical Project Manager (4699) with a strong technical background in the telecommunications industry to lead our projects in the European market.

As a Senior Technical Project Manager , you will be responsible for overseeing the planning, execution, and delivery of complex technical projects, ensuring they are completed on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards. This role requires excellent leadership skills, deep technical expertise, and a thorough understanding of the telecommunications landscape in the EU.

Job Responsibilities
• Lead the end-to-end management of complex technical projects in the telecommunications sector, from initiation to closure.
• Develop project plans, timelines, and budgets in collaboration with stakeholders, ensuring alignment with business objectives and customer requirements.
• Coordinate resources, including internal teams, external vendors, and subcontractors, to ensure project deliverables are... met on time and within budget.
• Manage project risks and issues, implementing mitigation strategies to minimize impact and ensure project success.
• Monitor project progress and performance, tracking key metrics and milestones to identify deviations and take corrective actions as needed.
• Communicate project status, updates, and risks to stakeholders, including executive management, customers, and project teams.
• Foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment, promoting teamwork, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.
• Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and industry standards relevant to telecommunications projects in the EU.
• Provide leadership and mentorship to project team members, supporting their professional growth and development.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineering, product management, sales, and operations, to drive project success and customer satisfaction

Job Requirements
• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical field. Master’s degree or PMP certification is a plus.
• Proven experience in project management roles within the telecommunications industry, with a focus on technical projects.
• Deep understanding of telecommunications technologies, including mobile networks, fixed-line networks, and emerging technologies such as 5G and IoT.
• Experience with project management methodologies such as Agile, Scrum, and Waterfall, with the ability to adapt approaches based on project needs.
• Strong leadership skills with the ability to inspire and motivate cross-functional teams to achieve project objectives.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to interact effectively with diverse stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritizing tasks and resources effectively to meet project deadlines and deliverables.
• Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to analyze complex issues and propose effective solutions.
• Experience working in a multicultural and multilingual environment, with proficiency in English (additional languages are a plus).
• Willingness to travel within the EU region as needed for project meetings, workshops, and customer engagements.
#J-18808-Ljbffr

jobs_results.title: (WO-293) Junior Project Manager
jobs_results.description: DescriptionGeneral informationLead the execution of small & medium-size projects and ensure that all related activities are performed in accordance with policy, contractual agreements, quality standards, health, safety & environment requirements, financial targets, as well as schedule commitments. The Projects would be related with our Grid Integration business (substations, power quality, e-mobility, etc). Your responsibilities- Lead the project team allocated to the project, defining main guidelines, allocating project tasks, and motivating and monitoring internal and external resources to accomplish all tasks and milestones. - Provide performance feedback regarding allocated resources working on projects;- Define, jointly with the Project Controls department, all project plan documents, including scope and financial plans, schedule and risk management plans;- Ensure that the project follows execution best practices and policies. - Effectively monitor and control project progress... and efficient resource utilization. - Monitor and control project financials, overseeing project invoicing status, cost, expenses and cash flow. - Identify, qualify, quantify and manage project risks, and ensure that all opportunities are identified and pursued. - Capture, analyze and share lessons learned throughout the project. - Ensure that the project is formally closed out, as contractually agreed. - Drive the formal acceptance of the project, contract close-out and its acknowledgement by the customer. - Ensure that the project consistently applies contract and claims management, in accordance with policies and contractual agreements. - Coordinate with Supply Chain Management, and successfully procures required services, materials and equipment for the project from external and internal suppliers. - Support Supply Chain Management in supplier negotiations, claims and project changes. - Act as key contact for the customer and an escalation point for project issues. - Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders and effectively communicate with all stakeholders. - Ensure the project follows and complies with company health, safety, and environmental policies. - Live core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues, and the business. Your background- A bachelor’s / master’s degree in Engineering- More than 2 years of professional experience, preferably including more than 2 years in project management. - Additional training in the area of project management- Demonstrated experience in management of project scope, cost, schedules or vendors / subcontractor- Demonstrated experience and knowledge of the energy business is also valuable- Customer oriented, with excellent organization and strong communication skills. - Mastery in balancing stakeholders, both external and internal. - Fluent in English and Spanish is a must, both written and spoken. French is also valuable- Current work permit valid in Spain. - Available to travel up to 20% of the time. It takes the brightest minds to be a technology leader. It takes imagination to create green energy for the generations to come. At Siemens Gamesa we make real what matters, join our global team.
Acquires and learns practical knowledge and working experience in different technical fields of expertise, in the course of an academic education.

Siemens Gamesa has a vision for renewable energy: we believe in the power of nature and technology. Help us to be ready to face the energy challenges of tomorrow and make a green footprint – join the team in creating a better future for us on our planet.
We focus on hiring the best people, wherever they may be in the world. We pride ourselves on the flexibility we offer to our employees and are committed to building a workforce that can grow with the... company. Siemens Gamesa is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
In our culture of trust, we focus on empowerment, diversity and continuous learning. Valuing our people is what makes us one global team, with our colleagues’ safety at the heart of our organization.

How to contribute to our vision
• Works as part-time or vacation temporary help in different technical tasks and operations.
• Performs all operations, measures, activities and tasks as assigned by accountable management or supervisor.
• Learns and acquires respective theory and know how, techniques, methods, tools and processes in the respective area.
• Supports other qualified staff in their tasks and accountabilities.
• Análisis, verificación e interpretación de datos y resultados generados en los reportes.
• Design and update Dashboards adapting to business needs.
• Define and document workflows/processes.
• Collaborate / Lead improvement projects.
• Support and close collaboration with regional teams in the process of implementation and optimization of processes and KPIs.
• Collaborate in improvement projects defined from Global.

What you need to make a difference

Passion for renewable energy and a sense for the importance to lead the change. We are also looking for…
• You are a graduate or recent graduate
• You have a minimum level of English B2
• Analytical ability.
• Communication skills
• You are an organized, independent and decisive person.
• Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office (Excel, Sharepoint, Power Apps).
• Knowledge in development and maintenance of Dashboards in Power BI will be an asset.

In return of your commitment we offer you…

• Become a part of our mission for sustainability: Clean energy for generations to come
• A global team of diverse colleagues who share passion for renewable energy
• Trust and empowerment to make your own ideas reality
• Personal and professional development to grow internally within our organization
• Flexible working hours as well as home-office
• Attractive remuneration package
• Local benefits such as subsided lunch, employee discounts and much more

Empowering our people

How do you imagine the future?

Our global team is on the front line of tackling the climate crisis, reducing carbon emissions – the greatest challenge we face.
Severely disabled applicants are encouraged to reach out to us. We have inclusive recruiting processes specifically for severely disabled persons and we do our utmost to tailor working spaces to suit your individual needs. In cases of severe disability, applicants who are equally qualified will be given preferential consideration.

Employment at Siemens Gamesa is based solely on an individual's merit and qualifications, which are directly related to job competence. We adhere to these principles in all aspects of employment, including recruiting, hiring, training, compensation, promotion and benefits.

We are driven by people - from more than 100 different countries, they build the company we are every day. Our diverse and inclusive culture encourages us to think outside the box, speak without fear, and be bold. We value the flexibility that our smart-working arrangements, our digital disconnection framework and our family-friendly practices bring to the new way of working.

jobs_results.title: PV Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
We are changing the world. We can start with yours.

Build an exciting, rewarding career with us – help us make a difference in thefuture of our planet. Consider joining the RP Global team, where you'll find a friendly work environment, opportunities for growth and development, recognition for your work, and competitive pay and benefits.

About RP Global

A privately-owned company with strong local teams on the ground in all its core Western and Eastern European markets: RP Global is a large-scale developer with 35+ years of experience in the renewable energy sector. As a developer, operator and investor, the company focuses on solar PV, wind, hydro and storage. RP Global is developing a pipeline of >15 GW(p). The company’s headquarters are in Vienna, Austria and Madrid, Spain. For our newly established office in Leipzig, we are looking for a PV Project Manager as an addition to our local team.

PV Project Manager

Reporting to the Country Manager Germany.

The new Project Manager... will be responsible for developing utility-scale PV projects in Germany.

Your responsibilities :
• To undertake and coordinate all necessary activities for the successful development of the projects, with the final target of reaching all the required permits for implementing the projects.
• To lead and manage relationships with third parties, “co-developers,” being sure that PV projects are always developed in line with main RPG technical/economical standards and are compliant with the main terms and conditions of the Development Service Agreement.
• Support the country manager/project director in the negotiation of preliminary land agreements (such as land lease agreements and/or purchase agreements) to ensure that contracts are always in line with RPG criteria.
• Drafting and assessing preliminary layouts (also proposed by co-developers) and proposing technical solutions to maximize the producibility of the plant/optimization of project layout.
• Critically assessing technical documentation prepared by co-developers with the aim of delivering “ high-quality ” output (documentation always in line with “BAT” and International/National technical frameworks).
• To develop and maintain excellent relations with local stakeholders, including landowners and local partners (e.g. , co-developers, engineering firms, agronomists, etc..)
• To proactively support the origination of new opportunities by identifying and securing the land plots needed for the implementation of the PV projects.
• To secure the most economical MV/HV grid connection and manage the application procedure for obtaining grid capacity with local DNO/TSO, as well as collaborate with co-developers/engineering firms.
• To lead and coordinate the process of designing of the MV/HV Substation needed to energize the projects.

Our requirements :
• Engineering degree (Electrical Engineering, Civil, Energy Engineering preferred)
• Advanced knowledge of technical guidelines applying to PV projects in Germany
• 3+ years of professional experience in Solar-PV projects preferred
• 3+ years of experience as a Development Project Manager in renewable energy, specifically Solar-PV projects
• High communication and negotiation skills
• Good knowledge of the English & German language, both written and spoken

What we offer :
• Newly established offices in Leipzig Centre
• A unique opportunity to support the expansion of our company in Germany;
• An attractive workplace and exciting tasks in an international work environment;
• A long-term career perspective at a privately owned company.

If this sounds interesting to you and you want to be part of a newly established team in an exciting and future-oriented sector, then we are very much looking forward to receiving your application! Please send us your CV & Cover Letter to Ver el correo electrónico en click.appcast.io .
#J-18808-Ljbffr

jobs_results.title: [DNK275] | Media Project Manager
jobs_results.description: Job Description As a Media Project Manager, you will be required to apply your knowledge in 360 media strategy and planning to the various cross-functional projects of the advertiser's different brands. You will need to coordinate all capabilities and practices of the Publicis Group and, in coordination with account directors, lead, develop, or collaborate on strategic and tactical cross-functional projects for all advertiser accounts. We are seeking candidates with a natural ability in project coordination and a passion for achieving new challenges. The ideal candidate should be dynamic, adaptable to change, and accustomed to working in high-demand environments with great efficiency in meeting deadlines. How you'd spend your day:Developing and collaborating on value-added cross-functional projects for the client, as well as media projects applied to all advertiser brands. Collaborating closely with the client to understand their needs and implement the requested projects or... proactively propose actions to be taken. Being the liaison connecting all resources of the Publicis Group, including the Zenith Client Services team, as well as external agents necessary to carry out all the work. Knowing and recruiting all best-case scenarios from the company and understanding their potential application for the market category in which the advertiser operates. Defining the structures and storytelling of project presentations. Supporting Zenith brand teams, understanding their issues and needs, and establishing projects to unlock situations or enhance our value proposition. QualificationsWhat we're looking for:Ability to manage and lead collaborative projects that require different profiles both internally and from clients or external partners. A deep knowledge in media strategy and planning in all its aspects (online and offline). To be highly creative, curious, observant, analytical, organized, meticulous, and capable of working under stress on certain occasions, with a clearly organized profile. Possessing a natural social ability, with extensive experience in client interaction. At least 10 years in the communication sector, of which at least 5 years have been in Media Agencies. We think you're awesome if you:Are proficient in English (B2 or more). Gran conocimiento de innovación en comunicaciónStrong and proven strategic problem solving skills. Fluidity with data & an ability to identify relevant data sources and translate data into meaningful insights. Strong communicator and storyteller. Proactivity and dynamism. #J-18808-Ljbffr

jobs_results.title: Molding Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
FormelD is the global service provider of the automotive industry. We develop market-leading concepts as well as individual, scalable solutions along the entire automotive value chain – from development to production to aftersales.

The company was founded in 1993 at its headquarters in Troisdorf near Cologne. Today we employ several thousand people from 45 nations in more than 90 locations in 22 countries. Passion drives us, professionalism makes us stand out and team spirit makes us successful. We work at the core of the industry that moves us every day.

Tasks & Responsibilities:

We are looking for a Molding Project Manager in Martorell area:

The candidate will be responsible for the development of new molds (and related automation), or improvements to existing ones, for the injection of plastic components. He/she will oversee the execution of each project, from the initial concept though design development, construction, start-up, validation and transfer to production.

He/she... will be the subject matter expert for any questions and inquiries related with plastic components, both internally and for our customers, with the goal of bringing in new business.

Tasks:

Lead engineering projects for the development of new molds and the improvement of existing ones
Work together with the clients (internal or external) in the product design development, including Design For Moldability (DFM)
Define user requirements and specifications for the molds
Lead the mold vendor selection to identify the right manufacturer for the mold
Follow up the mold design and construction
Define and execute test protocols for process development and performance verification (FAT/SAT).
Provide support for process validation
Create, track and meet project schedules, plans and budget
Coordinate with team members, as well as internal and external suppliers, through the different milestones and project reviews
Prepare the necessary documentation for the transfer to production (SOPs, maintenance plans, control plans, etc.)
Document the progress of the projects following the internal methodology
Provide engineering support to processes and equipment in production when necessary

We offer:

Permanent contract
Life insurance
Ticket restaurant

Skills & Knowledge:

Minimum education level: Engineering degree, ideally Mechanical Engineering
Minimum 5 year of experience in mold design and development, ideally in highly-regulated field
Proven ability to work in a cross-functional environment with all levels of leadership
Proficient with 3D CAD software, preferably SolidWorks
Microsoft Office Skills and basic knowledge of SAP
Fluent in English, speaking and writing

Job Location:

Employment Type:

Full-time
Online Application

We are looking forward to your application
#J-18808-Ljbffr
